metaplasticity.reason: Abraham & Bear 1996 coinage; multi-mechanism evidence (NMDA subunit, Ih, CaM/RC3, mGluR); astrocyte-mediated heterosynaptic form (Hulme 2014); AD developmental failure (Megill 2015); well-supported across labs

bcm-rule.reason: BCM 1982 theoretical framework validated by Kirkwood & Bear 1994 LTD experiments and Clothiaux 1991 simulations; molecular implementations proposed (Castellani 2001, Narayanan 2010); status mainstream rather than established because body-in full in vivo confirmation of the θ_m mechanism still limited

anterior-cingulate-cortex.reason: Anatomical features well-characterized (agranular, direct spinal projections); conflict monitoring fMRI replicated across many labs; ERN from ACC source well-localized; ACC lesion studies (monkey, rat) showing action value learning impairment are causal; EVC framework has multiple direct experimental validations; status established for the core findings, medium confidence for EVC as the complete explanatory framework
